FINDINGS.severity: MEDIUM — the C1 residual-class diagnostic under-reports
FINDINGS.title: unknown_entity_hints is blind on exactly the turns that matter
FINDINGS.detail: the reconciliation contribution loop does `if (_ceIsCarried(e)) continue;` BEFORE calling _ceAxisFor, so a carried entity never reaches the fallback and never joins _ceUnknownHints. Measured: exec 11645628 has M2399 (hint product_attachment, unrecognised) sitting in state all turn and emits NO unknown_entity_hints. The diagnostic therefore cannot measure a dormant immortal entity — only one that is actively contributing. Plan §2.1 presents it as the instrument that turns the residual-class premise from assumption into measurement; it only half does.

FINDINGS.severity: MEDIUM — customer-visible, scope boundary worth stating explicitly
FINDINGS.title: C1/C2/M2 do not clean a poisoned session on a pure reuse turn
FINDINGS.detail: exec 11645628: with M2399 + PC 000078 in state, 'send me the file again' returned a 26-product PC 000078 dump — the original carried-certificate-dump symptom — because nothing contributed, so nothing evicted. This is correct per the design ('a turn naming any product evicts it'), and M2 is what makes it correct rather than over-evicting, but the reviewer should know the customer-visible symptom survives on no-contribution turns until the user names something.

FINDINGS.title: sim-inject-session coerces absent referenced_result_set to [], which disables the parser's last_result_set fallback
FINDINGS.detail: sim-inject-session.js does `referenced_result_set: item.referenced_result_set ?? []`. output_exchange's byIdx block guards with `Array.isArray(parent_input.referenced_result_set) ? ... : prevState.last_result_set` — an EMPTY ARRAY passes Array.isArray, so the fallback is never taken and every position is out-of-range. Measured: exec 11646735 dead-ended ('no Certification matched these'); the identical fixture with an explicit referenced_result_set (exec 11646871) resolved correctly. NOT a live defect: on the live spine referenced_result_set is ABSENT in 62 of 67 executions, so Array.isArray is false and the fallback works. Any future sim-inject positional-pick fixture MUST pass referenced_result_set explicitly or it proves nothing.
